title: Hearty Molten Mexican Chickpeas Huaraches
description: A yeasty and molten solo dinner Mexican dish featuring chickpeas, perfect for a vegetarian friendly meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yeast, sugar, and warm water, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Add flour, salt, and vegetable oil to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces, shaping each into a thin circle.
Cook the dough circles for 2 minutes on each side, until they are lightly browned and crispy.
In a separate pan, heat some oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add chickpeas, oregano, and a pinch of salt to the pan, stirring to combine.
Place a cooked dough circle on a plate, top with the chickpea mixture, and sprinkle with cheese.
Place the plate under the broiler for 1 minute, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
